meta.source: Built from the Skyframe XR 2.0 pitch deck (Aug 2025), the SKYFRAME BY ARKFIELD brochure, the logo PNGs, the cover page and the Product Bible v2.0 (13 Nov 2026).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Frame Orange, the brand's signature colour, sampled from the logo (RGB 254,160,0). Use for fills: pill labels, primary buttons, highlight panels, the XR in the logo, chart bars. Never as text on Paper or White (2:1, fails); put Ink text on it instead (9.2:1).

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: Orange as TEXT or thin line on light grounds (links, small highlighted words, icons). 5.3:1 on Paper. On dark grounds it resolves to Frame Orange, which reads at 9.2:1 on Ink.

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Soft orange relief behind callouts, selected rows and quote panels. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on Frame Orange, in both themes. Never white on orange.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the logo letters. Near-black, never pure #000 in layouts (the logo files keep their own black). 18:1 on Paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, metadata, footers, axis labels. 5.7:1 on Paper, 8.8:1 on Ink.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. The warm off-white used across the pitch deck (Blueprint Paper). In dark mode, the Ink ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels that sit on Paper.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Dark bands in light layouts: feature bars, the traction timeline strip, footers, the code-entry screen. Text on it uses on-charcoal (14:1).

tokens.name: on-charcoal
tokens.usage: Text and line icons on Charcoal.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, dividers, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The 1.5px outline on Skyframe feature cards (the deck's signature outlined card) and focus rings.

tokens.name: concrete
tokens.usage: The grey concrete/blueprint ground from the brochure. Backgrounds behind architectural line art and photography.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status only: a valid Property Code, a published project, a completed download.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Status only: an invalid, expired or revoked Property Code; failed download.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Cover lines and deck title slides. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Slide titles and web hero headlines.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Tracked uppercase kicker above headings (the brochure's spaced caps). Always uppercase.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: See what you're buying, right where it will be.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Enter rooms, walk around furniture and judge room sizes at real scale.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Illustrative finishes. Final specification may vary.

styles.name: property-code
styles.usage: Property Codes in the app, on cards and in emails. Uppercase, grouped in fours.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, pill padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; pill padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; halftone dot pitch on small formats.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards; halftone dot pitch on covers.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile; slide margins.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero spacing, cover margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags, code cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons that are not pills, image frames, dark feature bars.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards and panels: echoes the rounded corners of the headset mark.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill labels, primary buttons, numbered step markers.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and table rules (colour: line).

tokens.name: border-outline
tokens.usage: The outlined Skyframe card and outline buttons (colour: line-strong). Matches the stroke weight of the headset in the logo.

shadow.note: Skyframe is flat: outlines, not shadows. One soft lift is allowed for floating UI only.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts and in-headset floating panels. Never on cards.
